attribution_limitations: The authors state they cannot rule out postoperative delirium as a contributor to the postoperative symptoms; the cause of the postoperative symptoms is not settled. Do not record postoperative delirium as a confirmed diagnosis.

The authors state it is unknown whether benzodiazepines were responsible for the coma after midazolam and that a CYP3A4 poor metabolizer status cannot be ruled out; neither is asserted. Do not record midazolam as the established cause of the coma or CYP3A4 poor metabolizer status as a fact.

The authors state it is difficult to determine whether the effects of dexmedetomidine were a direct pharmacological interaction or a secondary result of sedation. Do not record dexmedetomidine as the established cause of symptom improvement.

Artificial ventilation is stated only as "required"; its performance is not stated and stays unknown. Tracheotomy completion rests on the later tracheostomy cannula mention.
